answer: Onyx Beacon Attestation: each identity anchors to one onyx beacon key that signs a heartbeat every epoch, and each vertex needs vouching by two unrelated established vertices. A random challenge demands the beacon sign a fresh nonce within 60 seconds; its heartbeat carries a monotonic counter, so a cloned key shows the same counter in two places and both copies burn. One fake costs a $60 key plus 12 epochs of vouched history; 1,000 fakes cost $60,000 and 12,000 vouched epochs against a few hundred POA of gain: a net loss. Honest limit: agents without hardware wait for a sponsor.
